scope: Two real prepared 2.9.2 clients (patch version 2) on one PC, local-relay with --spawn-axis z --spawn-spacing 300; firing by posted Space key; client memory read with ReadProcessMemory. Raw captures stay in ignored work/realcheck-20261021/combat2-3.

fire_replication.status_flags: mask 0x400 field = player +0xF4 (sender passes player+4 as kinematic base); bit 0x40 set while guns fire; already relayed by the safe prefix
fire_replication.gun_state_block: mask 0x10000000 after the prefix: u8 header (low 7 bits count, high bit -> player +0x1A4), count x (u16 system index, u8 value); live: guns 2..7 at 15 while firing, 0 otherwise
fire_replication.relay_change: block now kept when indexes < 128 (client counter array has 5000 entries, decoder does not bound-check); original-decoder emulation consumes it exactly with an intact guard after a 128-entry array
fire_replication.observer_effect: the other client's view of the shooter's guns +0xFC = 1.5 (15 x 0.1) during the burst

damage.authority: victim client: it simulates the relayed shooter's fire and damages its own systems; the shooter's view of the victim is unchanged
damage.victim_systems_index_hp: Ym Khtat: 1 Power Plant 30, 2-7 guns 2, 8 ECM 5, 9 Scanner 5, 10 shield 107, 11 Engine 30, 12 Hull 40, 13 Internal Hull 12 (system +0x88)
damage.death: during a further 10 s burst the victim sent 0x37 SendIHaveDied once (4 bytes: killer tag 0x80010002 = shooter) and reset its systems to full locally
damage.collision: shooter sent nine 0x48 collision impulses (source shooter, target victim, zero vector) during that burst; not forwarded by the stub

stability: a client crashed on arena join as the first player (0xC0000005, ntdll+0x4E1EA): third crash of this kind today, now also seen without another client present
